title: Polish Almond Flatbread
description: A crispy flatbread topped with roasted almonds and a touch of Polish flair.
instructions: 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
3. Arrange the flatbread pieces on the prepared baking sheet.
4. Drizzle the olive oil over the flatbread.
5. Sprinkle the sliced almonds over the flatbread.
6. Sprinkle the sugar over the almonds.
7. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the flatbread is crispy and golden brown.
8. Remove from oven and sprinkle with salt to taste.
9. Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
